items.q: What will I learn in the SEO course?
items.a: On-page, off-page and technical SEO, content and link building, plus AI search optimization (AEO and GEO), across six modules.

items.q: Is the SEO course online or in Bhopal?
items.a: Both formats are available, in Bhopal and online. Ask our team for the next batch in your preferred format.

items.q: Can a beginner join the SEO course?
items.a: Yes. It starts from how people find businesses on Google and AI search, and builds up step by step.

items.q: How much is the SEO course fee?
items.a: Fill in the enquiry form or WhatsApp +91 84619 58162 and our team will share the fee, EMI options and batch dates.
Yes. Every learner who completes the program receives a completion certificate, which can be checked on our Verify Certificate page.

items.q: Which tools do I get to use?
items.a: You work with search and analytics tools such as Search Console and Google Analytics, along with our own free SEO tools.

items.q: Which jobs can I get after learning SEO?
items.a: SEO Executive, content marketer, technical SEO analyst and digital marketing executive roles, or you can offer SEO as a freelancer.

items.q: Can I use SEO for my own business afterwards?
items.a: Yes. You will know how to audit a site, plan keywords and track results in Search Console.
